answer_1.quote: We aim to mislead a structured prediction model by generating adversarial examples x from the original examples x using a seq2seq generator.
answer_1.outputs: adversarial sentences for structured prediction tasks

answer_2.quote: We use the perplexity on GPT-2 to evaluate the fluency of the generated sentences.

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation of the fluency and attacking efficiency. All the volunteers have a background of linguistic study and are proficient in English.
answer_4.guideline: For fluency, we ask them to rate the fluency of a sentence by an integer from 1 to 5. 5 indicates a sentence is fluent and has no grammatical errors. 1 indicates a sentence is full of grammatical errors and meaningless. For attacking efficiency, we ask them to manually annotate erroneous dependency edges and calculate the error rate in the same way as in automatic evaluation.
